claim: The repo states game data is packed in Oodle-compressed .arch06 archives (oo2core_5_win64.dll) and that the item database game.gamedb (magic 'GADB', ~55 MB) can be extracted from Patch_02.arch06 with QuickBMS's shadow_of_mordor.bms script.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN: repo records no game version, Steam buildid, exe hash or build check; it only states a ~112 MB x64 Steam exe with SteamStub v3.1 + Denuvo (docs/reverse-engineering.md:12,21-29). Our exe is 117732784 bytes (~112.3 MiB), consistent but not proof of 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001. Our install ships oo2core_5_win64.dll, consistent with the repo.
verification_method: Static read of repo. Verify by listing *.arch06 files and default.archcfg in our install (no extraction tool run).
limitations: Requires running third-party QuickBMS for extraction (not allowed in Phase 1). Archive format is not documented in the repo beyond this.
next_experiment: List archive filenames/sizes in our install read-only; defer extraction to a phase that allows tool execution.
